name: Icon
summary: A Lucide icon from the Doras set. Decorative unless it's given a label, and mirrored in right-to-left layouts when it points a direction.

when: Beside words, to help people scan.
On its own, inside an Icon button, which names it.

whenNot.text: For an action with only an icon.
Instead of words that people need.

anatomy.description: A Lucide icon, stroked in the current text colour.

props.name: name
props.description: Which icon, by its Lucide name, such as arrow-left. The Icons page lists them.

props.name: label
props.description: Its accessible name, when it carries meaning on its own. Without one, it's hidden from screen readers.

states.name: Named
states.description: Announced as an image with its label.

states.name: Mirrored
states.description: Flipped in right-to-left layouts, for icons that point a direction.

accessibility.name: Its label, if it has one.
screenReader: Labelled icons are announced as images with their label.
notes: Icons use the current text colour, so they stay visible in forced colours.
Arrows, undo, send and sign out mirror right to left; other icons never do.

related.relationship: For an action with only an icon.

guidelines: Label an icon only when it carries meaning on its own.
A label says what the icon means here, not what it shows.

dosAndDonts.dont: Rely on an icon alone to say something important.

evidence.point: Directional icons mirror in right-to-left languages; others don't.
